patch.value: Release and CI install Dependabot locks with the same pinned npm

Daily Release run 42412827958 failed before publishing because trusted tool and audit installs used npm 10.9.3 from Node 22.18.0 against the 091124b lock. Standardize release and CI on exact npm 11.21.0 before any locked install.

Inventory every workflow and script npm install with before and after runtimes; Pin and verify npm before trusted tool, provenance and caller installs while retaining node-version and ignore-scripts; PR CI executes the exact release production install against both committed locks; Document passing fixed and failing npm 10.9.3 runs against the unchanged 091124b fixture; Focused tests and typecheck pass; CI is the full gate; docs explain the caller runtime

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Repro: on main 091124b (Dependabot #254), npm 10.9.3 ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund reports EUSAGE: glob@13.0.6 does not satisfy glob@13.0.7. Reported npm 11.17.0 succeeds. CI already selects 11.21.0; release selects 11.19.0 only after tool bootstrap, while audit/alert/recover/Bun hooks inherit bundled npm. Plan: pin packageManager to 11.21.0, install and verify it immediately after setup-node in all reusable jobs, add isolated exact-command root/private PR CI smoke checks, retain lock bytes and lifecycle suppression.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Revert proof: immutable 091124b package.json/package-lock.json fixtures on real Node 22.18.0: exact npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund exits 1 with npm 10.9.3 (EUSAGE; glob@13.0.6 does not satisfy glob@13.0.7), exits 0 with npm 11.21.0 (5 production packages). Private provenance fixture passes with both npm versions (52 packages). All four runs preserve the lock SHA-256. In a disposable source copy, retaining new tests/manifests but restoring only both workflows to 091124b gives 0/3 pass and 3 failures; restoring fixed workflows gives 3/3 pass, no skips. Original worktree is never reverted. npm 11.21.0 engine range ^20.17.0 || >=22.9.0 admits the Node 22.18.0 default.

value.text: Expanded focused linked test run passes 112/112 with zero skips, including both real npm lifecycle/consumer tests and the fixture-precondition suite. First full gate measured all four coverage dimensions at 100% across 48 sources but reported three test failures: a newly introduced literal-name filter violated the existing fixture guard, and the npx bootstrap launcher propagated ignore-scripts into two lifecycle tests. value.text: Additional class instances found during the package-wide audit: request invokes only Node/GitHub commands and direct HTTP OIDC preflight, so its global npm bootstrap is unnecessary; verify_bun invokes npm only for a configured bunx hook. Removed request bootstrap and guarded Bun bootstrap with the same caller-hook condition as its locked install. Reconciliation/request tests prohibit installation commands in every metadata-only step, and all remaining reusable plus CI setup bodies retain exact-command and four-outcome checks. Interrupted the old Bun gate so final evidence will cover this broader fix; the prior npm gate passed 1635 tests with 2 platform skips, 100% all four dimensions across 48 sources, and all remaining release checks. A separate reused-checkout strict health check reports environment-specific extension-host skew and driver drift; no driver or dependency changes are authorized by this task, and fresh-checkout CI will verify health.

Exact bootstrap-command checks inspect every command in all 6 remaining reusable and 3 CI setups. On Node 26.13.0 with npm 11.21.0 and isolated Git configuration, npm run release:check and bun run release:check both pass: 1635 passed, 0 failed, 2 platform skips each; 100% statements/branches/functions/lines across all 48 measured sources, 0% duplication, 371 documented declarations, zero root/private audit vulnerabilities, and all changelog/attestation/lifecycle gates pass. Both locks remain unchanged from 091124b; original real npm 10.9.3 EUSAGE versus npm 11.21.0 lock proof is retained above. PR #260 remains the sole PR. Fresh-checkout CI and automated re-review follow the push; no release, publication or merge was performed. The separate reused-checkout strict-health environment warnings remain documented above.
